---
title: "Red Light Foundation"
format: html
execute: 
  echo: false
---


```{r}
#| warning: false
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# 1. Define the Sappy Story & Disproportionate Packages
foundation_text <- paste(
  "THE RED LIGHT FOUNDATION: STOP THE FLASHING",
  "\n\n",
  "THE TRAGEDY: Every night, goaltenders like Gordie stand alone in the cold crease.",
  "He tries his best. He really does. But then it happens: The buzzer sounds. The Red Light flashes.",
  "It burns his retinas with the color of failure. While the fans cheer and David Kane counts",
  "the record-breaking hot dog revenue from the extended stoppage, Gordie weeps inside his mask.",
  "The smell of victory sausages wafts down to the ice, mocking his emptiness.",
  "\n\n",
  "OUR MISSION: We cannot stop the pucks (neither can Gordie). But we can stop the loneliness.",
  "We provide emotional support animals—specifically seeing-eye dogs—to goalies who clearly",
  "cannot see the puck.",
  "\n\n",
  "PLEASE DONATE TODAY. CHOOSE A TIER (CURRENCY: KYRGYZSTANI SOM - KGS):",
  "\n\n",
  "TIER 1: 'THE PARTICIPATION TROPHY' — 14.50 KGS",
  "(Provides one (1) tissue for Gordie to dry his eyes during the TV timeout.)",
  "\n\n",
  "TIER 2: 'THE VIDEOTAPE REVIEW' — 865,000.00 KGS",
  "(We bribe the replay officials to disallow one goal per season.)",
  "\n\n",
  "TIER 3: 'THE VEZINA ILLUSION' — 4,200,999,999.00 KGS",
  "(We buy the opposing team and force them to shoot wide for 60 minutes.)",
  sep = " "
)

# 2. Render as a Document Image with 1.5 Spacing
ggplot() +
  xlim(0, 1) + ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_void() + # Removes the grey background/grid
  
  # Render the text
  annotate("text", 
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
           label = str_wrap(foundation_text, width = 60), 
           family = "serif",   # The "Executive Summary" font style
           size = 4.5,         # Readable text size
           lineheight = 1.5,   # The requested 1.5 spacing
           hjust = 0.5,        # Center align the text block
           vjust = 0.5) +
  
  # Add a red border for the "Red Light" theme
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(color = "#D32F2F", size = 5, fill = "white"))
```
